speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs (a) in each year for the past five years for cases involving offenders with mental disabilities or young suspects, how many instances have there been where an Appropriate Adult was not present during law enforcement interviews; (b) how many more volunteers are necessary to ensure that all eligible cases will have at least an Appropriate Adult present; and (c) what will be done to increase the recruitment of volunteers for the Appropriate Adult Schemes for Young Suspects and for Persons with Mental Disabilities.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: That said, there may be extenuating circumstances which necessitate the LEAs to exercise discretion not to activate an AA for the interview.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: For example, urgent interviews may be required to prevent the disposal of evidence, detain accomplices still at large, or prevent the commission of another offence.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: SCS and MINDS publicise volunteering opportunities for AAs through social media channels and during their community outreach.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: The Member may refer to media features in October 2022 for more information on the schemes and the volunteering experience.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Could I just ask what are the number and percentage of cases where the AA was not activated?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I think that would help to provide some sense of security for the suspect as well.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: As I mentioned, in the past five years, AAs have been successfully activated for all cases where the LEAs have requested for the AAs, based on the activation criteria.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: But, firstly, Sir, the first question really was – I think the Minister of State mentioned that there were some cases where the Police did not activate the AAs.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: How many cases were there and what was the percentage of the number of cases where they were not activated?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: The second was whether the same AA can be provided to the same suspect throughout all the interviews rather than just at one?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: Or maybe that is already in the current standard operating procedures?

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: But we will have to look at the timing of the interviews and we will have to schedule to the best of our ability.
